notes.title: Automate It's First Playtest
notes.notes:
🚀 Automate It Public Playtest Now Live! 🚀

We’re thrilled to announce that Automate It is now open for public playtesting! Dive into our unique mix of puzzle-solving and resource management, where you’ll construct intricate infrastructures using conveyor belts, machinery, and automation to tackle dynamic challenges in an industrial setting. This playtest is your chance to experience the game firsthand and help us fine-tune every detail.

🔹 What’s included: Explore early levels, test different mechanics, and give us feedback to make Automate It even better! 
🔹 How to Join: Simply click on the “Request Access” button on the Automate It Steam page to enter the playtest.

Your insights are crucial to us, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts. Thank you for being a part of this journey! Let’s automate it together!

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472770/Automate_It/]here[/url] to access the playtest page.

notes.title: The Hospital map is available now for free!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that a new map is available for free!

On the map The Hospital you will be reliving a memory of the first enemy faced by your character.

Duchess: She was the first threat faced, and was part of the training test. Unlike the enemies on previous maps, The Duchess is always on the hunt for you, and will chase you when she spots you. But this time you can use a fire extinguisher to escape her clutches.

Leecher: They are small creatures that hatch from scattered nests and prowl around the walls of the hospital. They only attack when they're not being watched, so keep your eyes peeled when walking past them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/8dfde1cfa1ae462a17532757ac3f1d2310f30f22.png[/img]

New Weapons: Five new weapons have been added for you to unlock. The order of unlocked weapons has also been readjusted to accommodate the new additions, as well as the level required to unlock them.

Voice system: The voice system was redone to bring more quality during its use. In addition, the voice system is part of one of the new mechanics of the new map.

Prison Settings:
Barkannan's height has been readjusted, making him slightly taller.
The step of flooding the cell area to turn the prison's power back on was removed as it wasn't in line with the flow of experience we wanted to present.
Foliage has been added to the outside area to create a better setting.
The map has had the lights optimized, and now supports Lumen and Nanite technologies.

Motel Settings:
Foliage has been added to the external areas to create a better setting environment.
The map has been redone for better optimization, and now supports Lumen and Nanite technologies.

We want to thank everyone for the support!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: The new map is available now for free!
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that a new map is available for free!

Check the trailer:

[previewyoutube=RmCb0npx0E0;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/bd34a4a9cda31bdd423ff94d0ffd99cd3cba7427.png[/img]

Brogloton, an Ancestral Spirit, has carried out a sudden attack on Motel Paradise, and there's no one better than you to deal with the threat. Complete the objectives, face off against Brogloton's lackeys and send him back to the spirit underworld.

Since at times the spirit can become invulnerable to gunfire, you can hide under the beds to avoid being caught.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/bbe604122024fe51ba8fd4828cb3dd88c3524f53.png[/img]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/35dffc7e549825af4598e6d2235fd8f34247a9c9.png[/img]

With a new boss, new enemies arrive. The Motel has four new enemies with unique behaviors. Each enemy has a different attack that can become a real obstacle.

Blorg: Throws itself at the player, causing stun for a few seconds.

Hornet: Stings the player, causing temporary hallucinations.

Screamer: Her scream weakens hearing and movement.

Spectro: Grabs the player causing slowdown.


Custom Difficulty has been added to allow you to control some variables that will let you play your way!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/2b2f91268fc7418bc43540ad82620892a754028a.png[/img]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/743c58ae974f861456c2a305a4a3b1420ee98a65.png[/img]

A level system has been added. Now you can unlock new characters and guns by playing and earning XP to up your level.

The old gun was removed and 5 new guns are added. They are:
Pistol, Revolver, SMG, Shotgun and Assault Rifle.

New rewards will be added in the future.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/33a4d46e06ac90f6976d0b3c3ea2b4969dc85e94.png[/img]

Cards, emoticons and backgrounds from Chased by Darkness are available now. You can use the new Background Images to customize your profile!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/e8b742bca4aadd31a15bf1ed967e718a11117989.png[/img]

We want to thank you all for your support! None of this would be possible without the support of the community!

There will be even more content in the future! So don't forget your life jacket, the sea will be very rough...

Special Thanks:

MissMackyMeow
RedMandaPanda
DayWalkerEm
PaisliePanda
Magoroku
Dopezo
Stoiss

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Upcoming Map - The Motel
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the new map, The Motel, is almost here! This time you will face Brogloton, the Ancestral Spirit. The new map brings new objectives and new mechanics that will allow more gameplay variety during the game.

New weapons and characters can be unlocked as you progress through the new level system. Earn XP every match to progress your level and receive characters and weapons as a reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/bbe604122024fe51ba8fd4828cb3dd88c3524f53.png[/img]

An Ancestral Spirit was summoned to murder a victim who was staying at Paradise Motel. The spirit, known as Brogloton, needed a host body to interact with the physical world, and ended up possessing the body of Mrs. Mary, a nice old woman who used to live in a nursing home, which is now controlled by a powerful and hungry entity. And to make matters worse, Brogloton has allies who will try to delay you and the banishment process.

Our goal is to launch The Motel in January 2022 for free.

Thanks for reading!

Discord: https://discord.gg/7Ncna2P7hH

notes.title: Future updates!
notes.notes:
First of all, we would like to thank everyone who supported us. And we also want to thank you for all your honest comments. Community feedback is very important for us to improve the game and meet your expectations.

We are a small indie studio located in Brazil, and our team is made of 3 members with a passion for games.

Unfortunately, some issues caused delays in updates. However, after a period with no news, we would like to announce that new updates are on the way!

What will come in the next update?

UI Redesign: We know that many liked the computer menu, but we had to redesign it to make the menu more optimized. New Graphics options have been added.
Control compatibility: Chased by Darkness now supports full control compatibility (with the exception of the parts that need to be typed on the keyboard, such as chat).
Voice chat improvements: Voice chat has been redone to achieve better quality.
Selection Lobby: The lobby has been redesigned. New features will be added in the future on the selection screen.
Minor aesthetic changes to the Prison map: We modified some environments on the map to make it look better.

The features cited will be updated soon. Also, we are working on a new map with new threats, new mechanics and new challenges! New information will be revealed soon.

Thanks for reading!
3+ Productions

notes.title: Chased by Darkness is now available!
notes.notes:
We're glad to announce that Chased by Darkness is available now and we want to thank everyone who has supported so far.

The game is in its gold version and we intend to do additional implementations in the coming months, such as the addition of DLSS and full controller compatibility. We have big plans for Chased by Darkness and we don't intend to abandon them. Feel free to make suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/7Ncna2P7hH]Discord[/url], report bugs and talk to us. We hope you enjoy the game and have a great experience. Stay safe!

Chased by Darkness is available now for £3.99 / €3.99 / $4.99. 

[previewyoutube=B-8hR5K3ySo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the game[/h2]

Chased by Darkness is a 1-4 players co-op survival horror. A new inmate brought with him a bestial spirit. Two days after his arrival, there was a mass suicide attempt in the penitentiary, among those involved were prisoners and prison officers. The authorities did not want to believe the victims reports of a supernatural force, but decided to evacuate the penitentiary until everything was cleared up. The prison warden called you, a clairvoyant, to help. Now, you will need to perform a ritual to purify the penitentiary and free it from the presence of Barkannan.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7Ncna2P7hH]Discord[/url].

Thanks for reading!
3+ Productions

notes.title: Chased by Darkness - Global Release
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h2]

With less than 1 week to the release of Chased by Darkness, we are here to show some of our future plans to this project.



[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
We try to deliver a game with the least amount of bugs possible. However, there is the possibility that new bugs appear, so we will constantly work to fix them quickly.


[b][h3]AI Improvement[/h3][/b]
We will be working to improve the AI of the enemies when possible. Your feedback is always welcome.


[b][h3]New Content[/h3][/b]
We plan to add more content over time, such as new maps, new enemies and new game modes, along with new mechanics to diversify your gameplay. 


[b][h3]Addition of DLSS[/h3][/b]
DLSS will be added soon as possible.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40363707/e75293c8b34143c02917569ff93d5c758b4eb268.png[/img]


[b]Chased by Darkness will be available 1st June 2021 for €3.99 / £3.99 / $4.99. If you are interested, support us by adding it to your Steam Wishlist! See you in June.[/b]

Thanks for reading!
3+ Productions.
